answer.rationale: Memory 44 directly supports qualified revenue through better enterprise pipeline quality, while memory 57 directly supports qualified revenue and retention durability. Memory 86 supports sustainable revenue indirectly through improved onboarding completion, time-to-value, and adoption. Memories 31 and 91 show durable or improved activation and engagement, but do not directly establish revenue quality, retention, or long-term economics. Memory 73 is least supported because it reports acquisition and revenue lift from promotional pricing but omits retention, margin impact, customer quality, and long-term sustainability—especially important given the current competitive price pressure.
